تتعايون (form VI)
# تَتَعَايَوْنَ (tataʕāyawna) /ta.ta.ʕaː.jaw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of تَعَايَا (taʕāyā)
# تُتَعَايَوْنَ (tutaʕāyawna) /tu.ta.ʕaː.jaw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of تَعَايَا (taʕāyā)
